items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: And he brought his trio and joined my clarinet and a tour in Japan.

ctx.x: And he brought his trio and joined my clarinet and a tour in Japan. The very first — I didn’t know Richard Wyands, and the first time to join.
The first time you played together, you hadn’t even met.
